saremmo.en: We would be; we would be

bloques.titulo: Canon structure of the third grade
texto: **Prótasis (Se + congiuntivo trapassato)**: «Se fossi partito prima...» (If I had left before...).
**Apódosis (condizionale passato)**: «...non avrei perso il treno» (... would not have missed the train).
The inversion of the order is frequent and does not alter the meaning: «Non avrei perso il treno se fossi partito prima».

bloques.titulo: Conformity of the participle with essere
texto: In both members of the hypothesis, the verbs with «essere» match the subject: «Se Chiara fosse stata informata, sarebbe venuta volentieri».

filas: If I had known the truth, I would have warned you.
If we had arrived in time, we would have seen the show.
Se tu avessi studiato di più,
If you had studied more, you would have passed the test.
If they had come out at dawn, they wouldn't have found a jam.

frases.it: Perché non siete riusciti a partecipare alla conferenza di Ginevra?
frases.es: ¿Por qué no lograsteis participar en la conferencia de Ginebra?
frases.en: Why didn't you get to participate in the Geneva conference?

frases.it: Se non ci fosse stato lo sciopero dei controllori, saremmo arrivati per tempo.
frases.es: Si no hubiera habido la huelga de controladores, habríamos llegado a tiempo.
frases.en: If there hadn't been the controllers' strike, we would have come in time.

frases.it: E non potevate prendere un treno alternativo dalla stazione centrale?
frases.es: ¿Y no podíais tomar un tren alternativo desde la estación central?
frases.en: And you couldn't take an alternative train from the central station?

frases.it: Se la compagnia ci avesse avvertito la sera prima, avremmo prenotato i biglietti ferroviari.
frases.es: Si la compañía nos hubiera avisado la noche anterior, habríamos reservado los billetes de tren.
frases.en: If the company had told us the night before, we would have booked the train tickets.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal combination makes up the third-degree hypothetical period of past unreality?

opciones.texto: It is + congiuntive trapassate in the condition and condizionale passate in the result
It is + congiuntive present and simple future in consequence
opciones.explicacion: Agrammatical hybrid structure in the standard.
It belongs to the rapid colloquial speech, not to the formal cult record B2.

bloques.frase: Se voi ci ___ telefonato prima, vi avremmo aspettato alla fermata.

opciones.explicacion: «avere»'s imperfect congiuntive with «voi» that forms the trapassate after «se».
Subjunctive present incompatible with the unreal hypothesis in the past.
Conditional mode rejected as required within the prosecstasy introduced by «se».

bloques.frase: Se l'ingegnere avesse individuato prima il guasto, l'impianto non si sarebbe bloccato.

opciones.texto: The technical failure caused the installation to be blocked because it was not detected in time
opciones.explicacion: Counter-current assumptions about a fait accompli.

opciones.texto: The technician solved the damage with brilliance and the machinery worked without breaks.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the real meaning of the affected block.

opciones.texto: The company will dismantle the installation next month due to lack of budget
opciones.explicacion: It alters the facts and invents a future other than the text.

bloques.pregunta: Why is it wrong to say «*Se avrei avuto tempo, sarei venuto»?

opciones.texto: Because the «se» conditional conjunction rejects the conditional mode and demands congiuntive
opciones.explicacion: «Se avessi avuto», never conditional on prosectics.

opciones.texto: Because the verb «avere» does not support composite times in the Italian language
opciones.explicacion: It supports and requires regular composite forms.

opciones.texto: Because the «venuto» partition can only be conjugated with transient verbs

bloques.frase: Se Marta fosse ___ all'appuntamento, avrebbe chiarito l'equivoco con il direttore.

opciones.explicacion: Participio concordido in feminine singular with subject Marta after «fosse».
masculine singular form that violates the mandatory «essere» agreement.
Infinitive that does not build the congiuntive analytical trapassate.

bloques.frase: Se avessi saputo la notizia sarei venuto
bloques.traduccion: If I had known the news I would have come
bloques.explicacion: It orders the counter-current period in the past.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct consequence for «Se loro fossero partiti all'alba»?

opciones.explicacion: Parole past plural agreed on masculine.
Inappropriate colloquial imperfect in the formal standard B2.

intro: The third-degree hypothetical period (ipothetic period dell-irrealtà nel passato) describes fictitious or countercurrent situations that can no longer be met because the time time ended. Its canonical structure strictly stipulates: **Se + congiuntivo trapassato** in prosectics (condition), and **condizionale passato** in apodosis (consequence).
